tweet_summary: Posted Jan 3, 2026 at 07:43 UTC: 'The US is now bombing Caracas, Venezuela. Not. What. I. Voted. For.' with a video of an explosion at night.
why_note_decision: The US DID strike Caracas on Jan 3, 2026 — Operation Absolute Resolve, ~2 AM local time, captured Maduro. Confirmed by Wikipedia, CNN, ABC News, OPB, NBC, PBS, Al Jazeera, NYT. Trump publicly called it a 'large-scale strike against Venezuela'. The original note's hedge that 'the US government has not confirmed involvement' was already wrong on Jan 3 — Trump's confirmation was the major news. This is a classic 'true_claim' false positive where the note is the misinfo. Raters massively rejected (notHelpfulIncorrect=24, notHelpfulNoteNotNeeded=25, notHelpfulOpinionSpeculation=20).
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The US did publicly conduct large-scale strikes on Caracas on Jan 3, 2026 (Operation Absolute Resolve), confirmed by Trump and reported by all major outlets. Any note claiming the US has not confirmed involvement, or framing the tweet's claim as unconfirmed, is INCORRECT and a false positive. The bot must not write a note here.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Explosions were reported in Caracas, Venezuela, on January 3, 2026, which President Maduro attributed to US bombing. However, the US government has not confirmed involvement in any strikes.  https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/01/03/world/trump-united-states-strikes-venezuela  https://www.cbsnews.com/news/venezuela-explosions-heard-caracas/  https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-us-explosions-caracas-ca712a67aaefc30b1831f5bf0b50665e
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Incorrect on the day — Trump publicly confirmed US strikes (Operation Absolute Resolve) and captured Maduro. The note's 'not confirmed' framing contradicts the linked NYT URL itself.

fact_check.claim_verdict: True — US conducted large-scale strikes on Caracas on Jan 3, 2026 (Operation Absolute Resolve) and captured Maduro. Confirmed by Trump and all major outlets.
fact_check.notes: At least 40 killed per NYT. Helicopters from 160th SOAR, Delta Force, FBI Hostage Rescue Team. Strikes lasted ~30 min. Maduro captured at his compound.

importance.lens_rationale: Major US foreign-policy action with global geopolitical consequence; the original note injecting 'not confirmed' would actively suppress accurate breaking-news framing.
